counterexample: Two of its 'no failure found' ranges were wrong (Skeptic review 2026-10-18, reviews/skeptic_C05_C08_C12.md, P2) - G(k+1) = 2G(k) + 2G(k-1) (1,2) fails at s = 6: (314965 o 314965) o 1 != 314965 o (314965 o 1); G(k+1) = 3G(k) + 3G(k-1) (1,5) fails at s = 10 and s = 11: (173938 o 173938) o 1 != 173938 o (173938 o 1). Both re-verified with the lab's code and re-found by EXP-C08-07 (e.g. (5653, 42197, 1) at s = 6; (3192, 173938, 1) at s = 10; (12100, 12100, 1) at s = 11). The certified lower bounds of this claim stand; the thresholds it implied for these two sequences do not. Superseded by CLM-C08-08.
